features.feature: Same-origin WordPress ACF REST API proxy
features.reach: GET /api/wp/acf/v3/options/options or GET /api/wp/wp/v2/pages?slug=...; proxies allowlisted WP endpoints server-side to eliminate client CORS errors on production and preview domains.
actions: Validate allowlisted WP endpoint and query params
Proxy upstream WP JSON with Cache-Control: no-store
Inspect commit SHA and deploy status HTML

features.reach: GET /health.json; returns { ok, status, commitSha, deploy }.
actions: Verify live commit SHA against expected merge SHA
